resources.string: Restart interface scopes only
Secondary, lower-disruption option. Reload verified interface hosts with root; Bluetooth/control modules are NOT reloaded.
No authenticated interface host reports yet. Enable the module and check loading first.

Restart only these verified processes:
%1$s

The status bar, control center or headset window may briefly disappear. Bluetooth control is not restarted, so this does NOT reload all module scopes. Each replacement must report the installed module before continuing. No data wipe or phone/computer reboot. Framework caches may still prevent reloading.
Authorize exact process exits
Checking and reloading %1$s…
Verified the installed module in %1$d replacement process(es). Optional hosts awaiting normal relaunch are NOT verified.
Stopped after verifying %1$d process(es): %2$s. No further processes will be signalled. Check loading again. Framework caches may prevent a process-only update; no reboot fallback is performed.
Stopped after %1$d verified process(es). A signal may already have been delivered; process/module recovery is unknown. No further signals will be sent. Check loading before any new attempt.
Reload all module scopes (DEBUG)
Root-required process restart: Android Bluetooth → Xiaomi Bluetooth → System UI. Supports authenticated old-module reports. Optional Xiaomi :ui is reloaded only if observed.

Requires authenticated API 102+ reports from com.android.bluetooth, com.xiaomi.bluetooth and com.android.systemui. Old module versions are accepted. Check loading first; unknown or active calls block restart.

DEBUG ONLY — authorize process exits for:
%1$s

Bluetooth/audio and device interconnect WILL briefly disconnect. System UI, the status bar and control center may disappear. No data wipe, phone reboot or computer power action.

This explicitly authorizes exact-PID termination and operating-system socket cleanup, NOT a graceful control-channel shutdown. It works with authenticated old-module reports; the old module need not implement a new command.

All required hosts, real package UIDs, root identities, idle call state and normal audio mode are checked before any signal. Providers restart before consumers: Android Bluetooth → Xiaomi Bluetooth → System UI, then observed Xiaomi :ui. Each required replacement must prove the installed version, revision and build instance. An indirect replacement is accepted only with fresh current-build proof.

Optional :ui may await normal relaunch; it will NOT be launched or claimed verified. Work continues if you leave this page; use Cancel to stop further operations. A delivered signal cannot be undone. Framework caches may still block reload; there is no automatic retry or reboot fallback.
